_about: Real output of the backend's voice modules for the phone's voice screens, made by tools/gen_phone_voice_cases.py: strict.status = jarvis_speech.status() (GET /api/voice/status), strict.answers = jarvis_voice_enroll.stage() (POST /api/voice/enroll), voices.status = jarvis_voices.status() (GET /api/voice/voices), voices.answers = its create/switch/delete/set_better (the POST routes). Speaker models, speech engines, the second card and the approval card are stand-ins. Folders, times and measured durations are made the same on every machine. Do not edit by hand: re-run the tool.
